concepts.gloss_en: Chesed — the divine attribute/sefirah of loving-kindness, identified with Avraham and with emunah; also 'torat chesed'

members.note: singular sefirah Chesed = Avraham = emunah; the archetypal attribute

concepts.gloss_en: Chasadim — the plural kabbalistic 'kindnesses/lights' (nehiru de-chochmeta), a technical class of mochin contrasted with dinim/havayot; not simply the singular sefirah Chesed

members.note: plural technical term for chasadim as expansions of light (חסד הוא נהירו דחכמתא), paired against הויות/dinin; distinct construct/usage from the singular attribute — keep separate per under-merge and plural signal

notes: Singular חסד names the sefirah/attribute (Avraham, emunah); plural חסדים functions as the kabbalistic class of 'chasadim' (lights, contrasted with gevurot/dinim). Related but not identity — kept separate.
